title: On positive automorphisms of algebras of operators on atomic Archimedean vector lattices
summary: Let $X$ be an Archimedean vector lattice. We investigate subalgebras of $\mathscr{L}(X)$ consisting of regular operators that contain all rank-one operators of the form $a \otimes \varphi_b$, where $a$ and $b$ are atoms of $X$ and $\varphi_b$ denotes the coordinate functional associated with $b$.
